qa_pairs.instruction: What unique property groups are defined for the Bidirectional eDirectory driver?
qa_pairs.output: The page identifies three unique property groups for the Bidirectional eDirectory driver: Driver Configuration, Global Configuration Values, and Trace Levels.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which driver properties are common to all drivers and therefore not unique to the Bidirectional eDirectory driver?
qa_pairs.output: Properties that are common to all drivers, and not unique to the Bidirectional eDirectory driver, include Named Password, Engine Control Values, Log Level, and other standard driver properties.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you view the detailed Driver Configuration documentation for the Bidirectional eDirectory driver?
qa_pairs.output: On the Bidirectional eDirectory driver properties page, click the link labeled "Driver Configuration" which points to driver-configuration.html to open the detailed Driver Configuration documentation.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you access the Global Configuration Values reference for the Bidirectional eDirectory driver?
qa_pairs.output: In the Bidirectional eDirectory driver properties page, select the "Global Configuration Values" link (global-configuration-values.html) to view the Global Configuration Values reference for this driver.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the main purpose of the Bidirectional eDirectory driver properties page.
qa_pairs.output: The Bidirectional eDirectory driver properties page lists the only unique property categories for this driver—Driver Configuration, Global Configuration Values, and Trace Levels—while directing users to the general Driver Properties guide for common settings such as Named Password, Engine Control Values, and Log Level.
